(3) Kendall's W recomputed by hand from the published rank matrix for the no-entropy run: rank sums 224 = m*n*(n+1)/2 as required, S=1036, tie correction T=120 (five projects tied at language_count=1), denominator = 64*336 - 8*120 = 20544, W = 12*1036/20544 = 0.6051, matching the script's 0.605. Declared qualitative ratings adopted 2026-07-25 from data/qualitative-ratings.json; they are author judgment and enter no computation.
